title: Overview
description:
# Overview
Sample data from an in-memory SQLite database, plus the GitHub API.

| Panel           | Source             | Refresh |
|-----------------|--------------------|---------|
| Visits per hour | SQLite, generated  | 10s     |
| Contributors    | api.github.com     | 10m     |

History shown: **{{ args.hours }} hours** (`:DbDashUpdateVariable hours 48`).

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE h(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM h WHERE n < {{ args.hours }} - 1)
SELECT printf('%02d:00', n % 24) AS hour,
       50 + abs(random() % 100) AS visits
FROM h

show.title: Visits per hour
show.description:
Random visits for each of the last **{{ args.hours }}** hours, from
`{{ meta.db_type }}` (panel {{ meta.panel_index }}, every {{ meta.interval // 1000 }}s).

query.sql:
SELECT 'IT' AS dept, 42 AS people UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 7
UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance', 15 UNION ALL SELECT 'R&D', 120

show.title: Headcount
show.description: A round pie (`renderer: circle`) of the headcount per department.

query.sql: SELECT datetime('now') AS now, abs(random() % 1000) AS orders

show.title: Now
show.description: A one-row table: the time of the query and a random number of orders.

show.title: Orders today
show.description:
One value in block digits with a thousands separator (`format: "{:,}"`); this panel
has its own database and refreshes every 10 s.

show.title: Top Neovim contributors
show.description:
Commits of the top 8 contributors to
[neovim/neovim](https://github.com/neovim/neovim), from `{{ meta.db_url }}`.
Unauthenticated API calls are limited to 60 an hour, hence the 10m interval.
